description: One worker on a heat record's acclimatization plan. OAR 437-004-1131(g) asks for a written plan for employees with fewer than fourteen days working in the heat — the crew most likely to be hospitalised, and the crew a headcount will not identify. The child table exists so the plan NAMES them: 'four unacclimatized workers' is a number an inspector cannot check and 'these four, by Employee record' is one they can.

fields.description: The worker the plan covers. A Link, so the plan can be reconciled to the crew list on the shift and to the training register — the three questions an inspector asks about a new worker in the heat are who they are, how long they have been doing it, and what they were taught.
fields.label: Employee

name: Heat Acclimatization Worker
